messages:
harry: Quick roll-up from the Aurora postmortem follow-ups. Short summary: transient VPC peering flap + on-prem KV cache race caused tenant traffic to default-route. Mapped owners + timeline below. Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/aurora-2026
incident-bot: Follow-up created: REM-6687 (aurora-remediate) — due: 14d — https://tracker.redwood.com/REM-6687
sophie: I can take the peering reconciler change. Plan: make reconcile idempotent, add route-overlap assertion, and a pre-apply sanity check. PR + staging by Thu. CHG-4870.
bryan: I'll own the KV invalidation bug. Repro on onprem-sim with ~11k concurrent clients; failing during shard-rebalance when kv_apply interleaves. Estimate ~72h incl unit + integration tests. PR when green: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1402
keiko: I'll handle customer comms and mitigation (edge fanout cap + temporary traffic shaping). Ticket: CUST-11999. Will request their firewall/peering windows.
harry: Owners recap: peering -> @sophie (CHG-4870 / REM-6687), kv/cache -> @bryan (REM-6687 / PR pending), comms -> @keiko (CUST-11999). Please add exact calendar dates and any blockers by EOD.
sophie: Customer allowed maintenance windows: Wed/Fri 00:00-04:00 UTC. Targeting Fri 01:00 UTC for the change; rollback steps documented.
bryan: Starting extended repro now. If green I'll open PR and aim for staging deploy Tue 09:00 UTC. Will attach test logs.
keiko: Draft notice is ready; will send 8h before the CHG window and schedule post-change validation call with customer's ops.
harry: Adding monitoring: create alert on "tenant_route_fallthrough" > 4/min and "kv_inconsistency" spikes. Linking alerts to REM-6687.
sophie: Adding controller-side guard: refuse apply when peer route ranges overlap unexpectedly; will include in CHG.
bryan: Adding integration coverage for shard-alignment during cache rebuild to avoid silent divergence of model shards.
incident-bot: Linked issues: REM-6687, CHG-4870, CUST-11999 — https://tracker.redwood.com/REM-6687
keiko: I'll send the customer update once CHG is scheduled and cc support + success.
harry: If we agree on timeline: sophie -> Fri 01:00 UTC, bryan -> staging Tue, keiko -> notice 8h prior. I'll mark immediate follow-ups closed and start a biweekly incident trends sync.
sophie: :thumbsup:
bryan: :thumbsup:
keiko: :thumbsup:
